limitations: Only one-dimensional once-reinforced random walks on the full line and reflected half-line are treated.
No quantitative rates, path-process functional limits, or results for general graphs are claimed.
The weak-weight half-normal regime requires c_n tending to zero.
Two historically relevant perturbed-walk primary works had no accessible complete text, so historical priority has residual uncertainty.
scientific_integrity: The claims follow from an exact renewal transform and a distributional inversion argument. Finite checks support, but do not prove, infinite asymptotic statements. No independent review or novelty certification has been carried out.
title: A universal weak-weight crossover for once-reinforced walk ranges
